main.description: An invite to join a performer's, party's or venue's space, keyed by the invitee's DID. Written by the Local Network root account for someone with people.manage, and deleted when they lose it. The invitee isn't a member until they accept, which replaces it with a computer.localnetwork.people.person record.

staff.description: Set when staff made it. It works whoever is in the space, where one someone in it made stops working once they can't add people.
